name: Fiendish Mantis

items.name: Ship-Bound
items.text: The mantis is fused to the ship and moves where the ship moves. It doesn't occupy a space of its own but is treated as being in the front 20-foot-by-20-foot space of the ship for the purpose of making attacks and being targeted.

items.name: Blood-Scent
items.text: After consuming the blood of a living creature, the mantis can track it (as the locate spell, but it functions over running water and has a range of 300 miles).

items.name: Fling
items.text: The deadly mantis flings a Grabbed creature into the air, up to 30 feet overhead and up to 30 feet away from the mantis (the creature takes damage from the fall as normal). If the flung creature lands on another creature, the creature it lands on takes the same amount of bludgeoning damage with a DC 31 basic Reflex save save.

items.name: Rending Mandibles
items.text: The mantis makes a mandibles Strike against a creature it has Grabbed. If that Strike hits and the creature is wearing armor with Hardness 12 or lower, the armor is broken. This Strike doesn't further damage armor that's already broken.

items.name: Sudden Strike
items.text: On the first round of combat, creatures that haven't acted are Off-Guard to the deadly mantis.

text:
These gigantic mantids make their homes within prehistoric forests.

---

These predators possess lightning-quick forelegs and a bone-breaking bite.
